permissions.body: Niba uhisemo gusikana kode QR, KaalKey ikoresha uruhushya rwa kamera kubyo bikorwa. Kwemeza ibikoresho bidahwitse hamwe nibitekerezo bishimishije ukoreshe ibiranga ibikoresho bijyanye. Urashobora gucunga uruhushya mugikoresho cyawe.
permissions.heading: 2. Uruhushya nibiranga ibikoresho

backups.body: Iyo uremye backup, KaalKey ihishe inyuma ukoresheje ijambo ryibanga wahisemo. Gumana dosiye nijambobanga wenyine kandi ubibike neza. Umuntu wese ubonye dosiye nijambobanga ryayo arashobora kugarura konti yawe yemewe. KaalKey ntishobora kugarura ijambo ryibanga ryibagiwe.
backups.heading: 3. Ibikubiyemo

security.body: Komeza ibikoresho byawe bigezweho, ubirinde ukoresheje ecran ya ecran, kandi ntugasangire OTP amabanga cyangwa ijambo ryibanga ryibanga. Kuraho porogaramu, gusiba amakuru yayo, cyangwa gutakaza igikoresho birashobora gutuma konti zabitswe zaho zitaboneka. Komeza kugarura umutekano niba ukeneye gukira.
security.heading: 5. Umutekano no kugumana

information.heading: 1. Amakuru n'amabanga
information.body: KaalKey ni porogaramu yemeza. Ibirango bya konti hamwe nibanga ryibanga rikenewe kugirango habeho inshuro imwe code irumva. Porogaramu yashizweho kugirango ibike inyandiko za konti mububiko bwizewe bwibikoresho. Umuntu wese ufite uburyo bwo gufungura igikoresho kidafunguwe cyangwa ibicuruzwa byoherejwe hanze ashobora kubona amakuru yunvikana.

sharing.heading: 4. Kugabana nabandi bantu
sharing.body: Kumanura ibintu birashobora gukoresha urupapuro rwibikoresho cyangwa igikoresho cya dosiye kugirango ubike, wohereze, cyangwa uhitemo dosiye. Imikorere yibanga ya porogaramu iyo ari yo yose cyangwa serivisi wahisemo igengwa nuwo mutanga. Iri tangazo ntirisobanura ko igikoresho cyawe, sisitemu y'imikorere, cyangwa serivisi wasanganywe zitigera zitunganya amakuru.

changes.heading: 6. Guhindura no kuvugana
changes.body: Iri tangazo ryashyizwemo rishobora gusubirwamo mugihe kizaza gisohoka. Kubibazo byihariye, hamagara uwamamaza porogaramu ukoresheje umuyoboro wemewe utangwa na porogaramu.

use.body: Urashobora gukoresha KaalKey kugirango ubyare kode yo kugenzura konti wemerewe kwinjira. Ushinzwe kubahiriza amategeko akurikizwa n'amategeko ya serivisi ukoresha kode yo kwemeza.
use.heading: 1. Gukoresha kwawe

protectAccounts.body: Ushinzwe kurinda igikoresho cyawe, amabanga yemeza, uburyo bwo kugarura ibintu, kohereza ibicuruzwa hanze, hamwe n’ibanga ryibanga. Ntugasangire kode cyangwa amabanga kubantu utizeye.
protectAccounts.heading: 2. Kurinda konti zawe

availability.body: Ibiranga birashobora guhinduka hagati yo gusohora. Ugomba gukomeza porogaramu ivugururwa kandi ukagenzura buri gihe ko gahunda yawe yo kugarura no kugarura ikora.
availability.heading: 5. Guhinduka no kuboneka

recovery.body: [] Komeza ubundi buryo bwo kugarura butangwa na serivisi bireba.
recovery.heading: 3. Nta garanti yo gukira

advice.heading: 4. Nta nama zumwuga
advice.body: Porogaramu ningirakamaro kandi ntabwo itanga inama zemewe n'amategeko, imari, cyangwa umutekano. Niba konte ibangamiwe, kurikiza serivise yibasiwe no kugarura no kuyobora umutekano.

liability.heading: 6. Inshingano n'amategeko akurikizwa
liability.body: Mugihe cyemewe namategeko akurikizwa, porogaramu itangwa nta garanti yimikorere idahagarara cyangwa idafite amakosa. Nta kintu na kimwe muri aya magambo gikubiyemo uburenganzira cyangwa imiti idashobora gukurwaho byemewe n'amategeko. Izindi mbogamizi zose cyangwa amategeko-agenga amategeko agomba gusubirwamo numunyamategeko ubishoboye kububasha bw'umwanditsi mbere yo kurekurwa.

legal.reviewBothDocuments: Nyamuneka suzuma inyandiko zombi mbere yo gukoresha KaalKey. Bashyizwe muri porogaramu kandi iraboneka kumurongo.
legal.reviewSPrivacy: Subiramo KaalKey amakuru yerekeye ubuzima bwite n'amabwiriza yo gukoresha.
legal.iReadAgree: Nasomye kandi nemera Politiki Yibanga n'amabwiriza yo gukoresha.
